name: Olaparib Maintenance (BRCA-mutated Epithelial Ovarian/Fallopian Tube/Primary Peritoneal Cancer)
disease: Epithelial ovarian, fallopian tube, and primary peritoneal cancer
histology: epithelial ovarian carcinoma (high-grade serous, grade 2/3 endometrioid, or BRCA1/2-mutated clear cell carcinoma or carcinosarcoma per the maintenance-eligible population). Fallopian tube and primary peritoneal carcinoma are treated as ovarian carcinoma.

biomarkers.BRCA1_2: germline or somatic pathogenic/likely pathogenic (P/LP) variant required
biomarkers.note: Biomarker gated: single-agent olaparib maintenance requires a germline or somatic BRCA1/2 P/LP variant. Per Standard Guidelines (NCCN) Ovarian OV-5, olaparib is a category 1 post-primary maintenance option for BRCA1/2-mutated disease; it is also listed for BRCA1/2 wild-type or unknown with HR deficiency, but FDA labeling restricts single-agent olaparib to germline or somatic BRCA-mutated disease. In the post-recurrence maintenance setting, PARP inhibitor maintenance is restricted to the BRCA1/2-mutated setting (OV-D footnote a) and requires no prior progression on a PARP inhibitor.

lineOfTherapy: maintenance after response (CR or PR) to platinum-based primary therapy (post-primary), or after response to platinum-based recurrence therapy (post-recurrence, BRCA-mutated only)

eligibilityCriteria.requirement: germline or somatic BRCA1/2 pathogenic or likely pathogenic variant
eligibilityCriteria.locator: v4.2026, OV-5 (Germline or somatic BRCA1/2 P/LP variants: Olaparib category 1)

eligibilityCriteria.requirement: complete or partial response after platinum-based therapy
eligibilityCriteria.locator: v4.2026, OV-D Principles of Maintenance PARP Inhibitor Therapy (Post Primary and Post Recurrence Treatment)

eligibilityCriteria.requirement: post-recurrence use requires no prior progression on a PARP inhibitor
eligibilityCriteria.locator: v4.2026, OV-D Post Recurrence Treatment; footnote a (post-recurrence restricted to BRCA1/2-mutated)

drugs.name: Olaparib

provenance.source: Standard Guidelines (NCCN), Ovarian Cancer/Fallopian Tube Cancer/Primary Peritoneal Cancer
provenance.locator: OV-D, Principles of Maintenance PARP Inhibitor Therapy, Olaparib monotherapy (Olaparib 300 mg PO twice daily)

drugs.notes: Source: Standard Guidelines (NCCN) v4.2026, OV-D Principles of Maintenance PARP Inhibitor Therapy. Olaparib 300 mg PO twice daily, taken continuously (cycleLengthDays 1 represents continuous daily dosing). Refer to the package insert for renal or hepatic dose adjustments and for tablet-versus-capsule bioequivalence (the 300 mg dose is the tablet formulation).

regimen.cycles: continuous twice-daily dosing; up to 2 years post-primary maintenance unless disease progression or unacceptable toxicity (may continue beyond 2 years if not in CR); until progression or unacceptable toxicity in the post-recurrence maintenance setting
supportiveCare: monitor for cytopenias; olaparib can cause myelosuppression and carries a risk of myelodysplastic syndrome or acute myeloid leukemia with prolonged exposure.
antiemetic support as needed for nausea per package insert.

monitoring: CBC: careful monitoring of blood counts is required (baseline and periodic; hold for prolonged cytopenia and evaluate for MDS/AML)
renal and hepatic function monitoring is recommended
blood pressure monitoring is recommended for olaparib (required for niraparib)

doseModificationRules.text: Interrupt and consider dose reduction per package insert; if cytopenia is prolonged, evaluate for MDS/AML before resuming. Physician decides.

provenanceNote: ONCQIS Standard Protocol draft for single-agent olaparib maintenance in BRCA1/2-mutated epithelial ovarian carcinoma (StewardMD reference disease ovarian_cancer, subtype #44; shared framework with HGSOC #45, fallopian tube #46, primary peritoneal #47). Dose grounded to Standard Guidelines (NCCN) v4.2026, OV-D Principles of Maintenance PARP Inhibitor Therapy: Olaparib 300 mg PO twice daily, up to 2 years in the post-primary setting (until progression or unacceptable toxicity), or until progression in the post-recurrence setting. Biomarker gate: germline or somatic BRCA1/2 P/LP variant (OV-5, category 1 post-primary), with post-recurrence PARP maintenance restricted to BRCA1/2-mutated disease and requiring no prior PARP progression (OV-D footnote a). The olaparib 300 mg twice-daily dose and SOLO-1 2-year maintenance duration are corroborated in DeVita 12th ed. (lines 178661 and 179561). Blood-count monitoring is required with MDS/AML surveillance on prolonged exposure. No field is set to VERIFY. This remains a StewardMD Standard Protocol; no endorsement implied.
